g.text: Search -> click -> the app attaches the right drive automatically
The machine you are working on
recognised by your browser IP - config/remote_hosts.yaml
The app host (the machine running the app)
any host: laptop, server or NAS
external USB drive / stick / SD (sticker ARCHIVE-DISK-XXX)
calls the current machine's agent: bind -> attach
The drive, now visible on the host
USB/IP over TCP 3240 (unencrypted -> LAN-only) + agent call with token
If the drive is offline: prompt + auto-detect
and opens the file as soon as the agent sees the drive.
a small per-machine agent -> the app handles
detect, share, attach and open end-to-end (hands-off).
Fallback if the agent is unavailable:
1) Persistent bind: pin the drive once (admin), then auto-shared.
2) Hybrid: agent where possible, persistent bind as safety net.
3) Manual: Network-USB panel (usbipd bind by hand).
click Open on an offline file
